title: Pilgerreise zur seligen Ewigkeit
summary: "Pilgerreise zur seligen Ewigkeit" by John Bunyan is a Christian allegory written in 1678. This Protestant devotional work follows Christian, an everyman weighed down by sin's burden, as he journeys from the City of Destruction toward the Celestial City atop Mount Zion. Along the treacherous path, he encounters guides, tempters, and obstacles that test his faith. Through vivid symbolic landscapes and characters, Bunyan crafted one of English literature's most enduring spiritual journeys—a tale that has influenced countless writers and been translated into over 200 languages.
